tools.name: search_vouchers
tools.description: Search the live catalogue of IT certification exam vouchers by exam code or name, optionally within one vendor (microsoft, aws, comptia, fortinet, ine, redhat, databricks). Returns price, official price, stock and links.

tools.name: get_voucher
tools.description: Full details for one exam voucher by exam code: price, validity, delivery time, exam provider, regions and facts.

tools.name: compare_price
tools.description: Our price versus the exam vendor's official price for one exam code, with the amount and percentage saved and the source of the official price.

tools.name: get_policies
tools.description: Who the seller is and the delivery, refund, validity, payment and support policies.

tools.name: buy_link
tools.description: Returns a checkout URL with the voucher already in the cart. The user opens it, enters their email and pays on the website. This tool does not purchase anything.
